additional_concerns: Both formulas convert preservation of an application's existing processing route into a change-level exclusion from relief. That interpretation is plausible for a pending application, but the source does not establish its duration or consequences after withdrawal, disposal or replacement.
Both formulas freeze pending status at 28 November 2025. The transition passage does not expressly specify when the absence of approval or authorisation is tested.

The source states both “will take immediate effect” and “will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).” The explicit implementation date supports the threshold, but the relationship between these statements and the legally relevant assessment event remains unresolved.
The FAQs, forms, checklists and existing approval process are not supplied. Neither null-hash dependency ID is identifiable as a particular missing authority; no catalogue mapping can be inferred.

Home-jurisdiction compliance and product-feature and policy classifications remain supplied judgments. Actual application requires applicable home-jurisdiction rules and any necessary SFC interpretive guidance.
The geographical and UK UCITS scope matches footnote 1. False results do not establish an approval obligation; true results do not establish overall compliance.

An external-reference statement does not itself require an additional Boolean eligibility condition. Missing external text prevents assessment of substantive completeness but does not alone establish an executable omission.
